exhibits.quote: I won't use 20 downloads each month, but I don't feel the need to hoard designs.

trials.claim: Each downloaded design comes with free unlimited updates for life
trials.claimQuote: Each downloaded design comes with free, unlimited updates for life so you never have to worry about outdated templates.
trials.reasoning: The review says many designs date from 2015 and feel irrelevant, but it does not say downloaded designs failed to receive updates, so it is too indirect to prove or disprove lifetime updates.

exhibits.quote: 60-80% of the designs are back from 2015 and not necessarily relevant anymore in 2020.
exhibits.argument: If designs from 2015 remain irrelevant in 2020, they did not receive meaningful lifetime updates.

trials.claim: Downloaded items get unlimited updates for life
trials.claimQuote:
- Curated fonts, graphics, templates, themes, mobile app designs & ui kits, and more
- New handpicked premium items added every month
- Unlimited updates for life on all downloaded items
trials.reasoning: The review complains that many designs are old and irrelevant, but it does not address whether downloaded items actually received updates, so the lifetime-update claim remains unchecked.

exhibits.quote: 60-80% of the designs are back from 2015 and not necessarily relevant anymore in 2020.
exhibits.argument: If most designs are old and no longer relevant, unlimited updates for life are not occurring in practice.

trials.claim: EpicPxls is a curated online portfolio of design resources to ship projects faster
trials.claimQuote: EpicPxls is a carefully curated, online portfolio of design resources that helps you ship projects faster.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say the licensing makes assets almost impossible to use in practice and that graphics in some areas are mediocre, which materially undercuts the claims of careful curation and helping users ship projects faster.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue is the licensing — the assets are almost impossible to use in practice.
exhibits.argument: Assets that cannot practically be used undermine the claim of helping users ship projects faster.

exhibits.quote: Graphics in some areas rather mediocre, but ok for the price
exhibits.argument: Mediocre graphics undermine the claim of being a carefully curated portfolio.

exhibits.quote: pricePlans is a Handy service that offers a wide range of premium designs fonts, icons, and UI Kits )
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms EpicPxls offers a wide range of premium design resources.

exhibits.quote: With EpicPxls being a dedicated graphic and UX design resource I find the quality to be as good as Adobe Stock for those types of resources.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms EpicPxls is a dedicated graphic and design resource.

trials.claim: Users can browse and download from a library of templates, fonts, graphics and more to create customized sites or apps
trials.claimQuote: With EpicPxls, you can browse, and download from, a library of beautiful templates, fonts, graphics and more to create your own customized site or app.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say licensing makes assets almost impossible to use in practice and that quite a few items lead only to closed external pages, materially limiting browsing, downloading, and using the library to build sites or apps.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue is the licensing — the assets are almost impossible to use in practice.
exhibits.argument: If assets cannot practically be used, users cannot use the library to create customized sites or apps.

exhibits.quote: There are quite a few items that can only be found on external, but already closed pages
exhibits.argument: Items leading to closed external pages cannot actually be browsed and downloaded from the library.

exhibits.quote: With my 1st download, I was able to complete a website! 😃
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms downloading assets to complete a website.

exhibits.quote: Chock-full of Template Files, Graphics, and UI Elements that are perfect for quick mockups, ideas and inspiration.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the library contains template files, graphics and UI elements for projects.
